what_changed: curriculum_v1._try_explore no longer returns an unconditional refusal. It reaches computer_env_v1.discover() when -- and only when -- unconfined_exploration_refusal() says the admitted-confinement carrier is available AND a temporary workspace can be created. Otherwise the original boundary refusal is returned unchanged.

measured_after.interpretation: the recipe learned once is recalled and re-verified in a NEW PROCESS without re-searching. That is the permanent one-shot learning the thesis claims, working through the curriculum instead of beside it.

the_bug_i_introduced_and_the_test_that_c.why_it_is_wrong: len(plan) is the length of the ANSWER, not the size of the SEARCH. It reported 1 for a discovery that examined 33 programs.
the_bug_i_introduced_and_the_test_that_c.how_it_was_found: the existing test test_the_channel_reports_how_many_actions_it_tried asserts actions_tried > 1 and failed
the_bug_i_introduced_and_the_test_that_c.the_fix: carry discover()'s own count (len(progs)) and report None when it is absent, because an unknown number must not be rendered as a plausible one
the_bug_i_introduced_and_the_test_that_c.the_law: a channel reports the work it did, never a number that merely looks right

guards_preserved: the boundary refusal when the carrier is unavailable or no temporary workspace can be made
what_is_NOT_claimed: that this makes computer use solved. It connects ONE channel on ONE machine for a class of goals with a checkable output format.
that the other three channels (_try_with, _try_synthesize, _try_documentation) are connected. They still return the boundary refusal.
that this lifts the MiniWob reach number, which is a separate GUI path and unchanged at 56.3%.
that permanent learning is general. It is measured for goals whose success can be verified by a file of the requested format appearing.
why_this_round_matters_more_than_the_las: for eighteen rounds the gap was always a capability gap or a measurement error. This one was a wiring gap: the capability existed, was tested, ran in 26 ms, and the curriculum returned a constant. Finding it required running both ends of a call path separately and comparing them, which is the only method that could have found it.
